purpose: 原创造型候选板，非可驱动模型
prompt: Create one polished professional character-design comparison board for an original virtual news host for a Chinese channel called Earth People Log. The user wants the finish quality of sophisticated anime VTubers, rather than a simple cartoon icon. Landscape board, three equal roomy vertical columns labelled only A, B, C; off-white background, thin pale teal dividers, no scene or livestream UI. Each column has one large waist-up original adult host character with exquisitely drawn expressive eyes, refined face and hands, clean cel shading and delicate hair highlights, and below it two smaller face-expression studies (thoughtful, amused). Consistent high-end 2D anime Live2D concept-art presentation, readable silhouettes and carefully designed clothing suited to a clever, humorous observer of human civilization. A: friendly feminine adult observer with pale mint short layered hair, small single orbit-shaped metallic hair clip, cream field jacket over a dark teal high-collar shirt, small logbook emblem, warm intelligent smile. B: feminine adult field archivist with chestnut hair in a low side ponytail, thin round glasses, ivory and muted forest-teal tailored reporter vest and blouse, expressive raised eyebrow, no cap. C: androgynous adult space correspondent with dark slate short hair, one subtle mint streak, a charcoal and light-grey futuristic tailored jacket with teal piping, calm amused expression. Professional and approachable rather than childish. All outfits have distinct original designs and a tiny abstract globe/logbook motif. Natural proportions, modest practical clothing. Avoid copying any existing VTuber character, avoid navy sailor uniforms, bows, anchor jewelry, streaming screenshot decorations, chibi bodies, plastic 3D dolls, generic SVG flat art. Small study faces must match each corresponding main design. No animation claims, no technical rig diagram, no watermarks, no text besides A B C. This is a visual exploration board, not a finished rigged avatar.
user_selection: C：深色发通讯员，用户明确选择
